A1.justification: Both PDFs describe NaviMaster and provide readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–I. All substantive material can be matched despite changed bibliography pagination.

before.justification: v3 reports original GUI, spatial-affordance, and embodied-navigation experiments in Tables 1–3, with ablations and case studies in Section 4.4 and Appendices G–I.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experimental results, including the benchmark comparisons, ablations, threshold analyses, and appendix case studies.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same visual-target trajectory collection, action spaces, reasoning-history inputs, GRPO training, and distance/depth-aware reward. No method component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Training sources and evaluated GUI, spatial-affordance, ObjectNav, and visual-relation coverage are unchanged. Appendix I also retains the same individual and combined GUI/embodied case studies.

E2.justification: Tables 1–3 and the supplementary comparisons retain identical comparator membership. The updated GUI-shift bibliography entry corresponds to the same UI-shift comparator in Table 1; newly cited works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendices D–F and H retain the same splits, sample counts, model configurations, image resolutions, metrics, and thresholds. The main training setup remains 20k samples and three epochs.

E4.justification: The data-ratio, model-size, data-scale, reward, training-order, and threshold analyses are unchanged in Figures 4–5 and 7 and Appendices G–H. Appendix I contains the same case studies.

E5.justification: Appendix G.1 retains the statement that results average multiple trials. Neither version specifies exact trial counts or seeds, or adds confidence intervals, significance tests, or other uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: Reported scores, plotted trends, and case-study outputs match throughout both PDFs. For example, Table 3 retains NaviMaster's 33.20 SR and 12.60 SPL. No result entries are added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: The MDP formulation, coordinate transformations, advantage and reward equations, action-space definitions, and Appendix H mathematical reasoning are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about unified GUI/embodied navigation, visual-target trajectories, dense rewards, efficiency, and OOD generalization.

C2.justification: Interpretations of mixed training, reward efficiency, and depth-based robustness remain unchanged. The limitation concerning the absence of interleaved GUI/embodied training trajectories and the broader-impact discussion are also retained.

D1.justification: Implementation, hardware, hyperparameters, prompts, sampling, and history-truncation details remain unchanged. Both PDFs provide the same stated code, data, and checkpoint access information.

R1.justification: Sections 1–2 add eleven cited works, including an efficient-MLLM survey, CompassNav, GUI-Shepherd, and Android Coach. These additions broaden citations within existing prose without substantially revising the paper's positioning or distinctions from EWA and OmniActor.

P1.justification: v4 adds an Acknowledgement section, reverses the corresponding-author email order, updates publication metadata, and consolidates duplicate Android in the Wild and OS-Atlas references. Section 2.2 removes the IoU and classification-accuracy examples; the scientific narrative otherwise remains stable.

P2.justification: Citation additions cause local text reflow, and the acknowledgement moves the References heading to the right column on page 9. The expanded bibliography shifts appendix pagination. Figures 1–11 and Tables 1–11 retain their content, designs, and captions.

improvement.justification: v4 updates publication details and removes duplicate references, while Section 2.2 loses two illustrative reward examples. These limited editorial changes leave the method, empirical support, reproducibility information, and limitations unchanged across the main text and appendices, producing no meaningful net difference in overall quality.
